items.title: Hahn Arroyo and Paseo del Nordeste Trail Guide
items.description: Guides riders along the three-mile Hahn Arroyo segment of Paseo del Nordeste, combining access and crossing guidance with flood-control engineering, public art, neighborhood history, parks, library connections, route mileage, photographs, and the trail’s North Diversion Channel junction.

items.title: Paseo de la Mesa Trail Guide
items.description: Guides an eight-mile ride across Albuquerque’s Northwest Mesa from the volcanoes to the Bosque, combining route directions, parking, trail connections, geology, cultural and natural history, public art, neighborhoods, and views of Petroglyph National Monument.
items.provenance_status: official City trail-guide library and byte-identical source file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative eight-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; extracted text and representative rendered pages were reviewed.

items.title: North Diversion Channel and Paseo del Nordeste Trail Guide
items.description: Guides riders along the North Diversion Channel and Paseo del Nordeste trails from Balloon Fiesta Park to UNM, combining access and crossing directions with flood-control history, public art, parks, railroads, neighborhoods, arroyos, maps, mileage, and photographs.
items.provenance_status: official City trail-guide library and byte-identical source file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 11-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; extracted text and representative rendered pages were reviewed.

The 62877513-byte original exceeds 25 MB because its photo-rich pages retain high-resolution imagery; a smaller authoritative abridgment exists but omits substantial historical, engineering, route, and photographic content.
Optimization is technically possible but would alter the authoritative source; no recompression, downsampling, or conversion was performed.

A smaller official abridgment exists, but it omits substantial route, historical, engineering, and photographic content.
